Lycopene E160(d). CAS — 502-65-8. Pharmacopoeias. In US which also includes Tomato Extract Containing Lycopene. USP 31 (Lycopene). A mixture of geometrical isomers of lyco- pene. Store in airtight containers under an inert gas at a tempera- ture of 8° to 15°. Protect from light. Profile Lycopene is a carotenoid responsible for the red colour of toma- toes and some other fruits including rose fruit (p.2381). It is used as a colouring agent and antoxidant. Much interest has been ex- pressed in the antoxidant properties of lycopene for the potential prevention of diseases such as cardiovascular disease and some cancers, particularly of the prostate gland. Lycopene is also an ingredient of some skin preparations. ◊ References. 1. Everson KM, McQueen CE. Lycopene for prevention and treat- ment of prostate cancer. Am J Health-Syst Pharm 2004; 61: 1562–6.
